title: AUTOSAR BSW Diagnostics Engineer with C++ for ADAS
description:
At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to life\-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R\&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.


**Location:** Bangalore / Chennai
  

**Experience:** 5–12 Years


Join a team developing advanced automotive software solutions for next\-generation ADAS and vehicle platforms. As an AUTOSAR BSW Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and enhancing Basic Software (BSW) modules, communication stacks, and diagnostic services to support high\-performance automotive systems.


### **Your Role**


You will work on AUTOSAR BSW development with a focus on communication, diagnostics, failure management, and non\-volatile memory services. You will collaborate with system architects, application teams, and integration engineers to deliver robust and scalable automotive software solutions.


### **In this role, you will:**


* Develop and maintain AUTOSAR BSW communication modules including Ethernet, SOME/IP, J1939, and CAN\-FD.
* Design and implement diagnostic services, failure management, and NVRAM (NvM) modules.
* Configure, customize, and enhance AUTOSAR Basic Software components to meet project requirements.
* Integrate and validate communication and diagnostic stacks across vehicle platforms.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software issues in embedded automotive environments.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on system integration, validation, and performance optimization.
* Participate in software architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design activities.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation and support testing activities throughout the development lifecycle.

### **Your Profile**


* Strong hands\-on experience in AUTOSAR BSW development.
* Expertise in Communication Stack development, including Ethernet, SOME/IP, J1939, and CAN\-FD.
* Experience in AUTOSAR Diagnostics, Failure Management, and NvM module development.
* Good understanding of automotive software architecture and embedded systems.
* Strong proficiency in Embedded C programming.
* Experience with automotive communication protocols and diagnostic concepts.
* Strong debugging, integration, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience working with automotive development and validation tools.
* ADAS Video and Radar product\-line BSW software development experience is highly preferred.
* Familiarity with automotive functional safety and software development processes is an added advantage.

### **What You'll Love About Working Here**


* Opportunity to work on cutting\-edge ADAS, radar, and vision\-based automotive technologies.
* Exposure to advanced AUTOSAR platforms and communication frameworks.
* Collaborative environment with experienced automotive software engineering teams.
* Continuous learning and growth in next\-generation vehicle and mobility technologies.
**About Capgemini In India**
----------------------------


Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22\.1 billion.Capgemini in India comprises nearly 235,000 team members working across 13 locations: Bangalore, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Coimbatore, Gandhinagar, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Noida, Pune, Salem, and Tiruchirappalli.Make it real \| www.capgemini.com/in\-en.


Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

description:
### **Job Information**

	+ RESTful Web APIs

### **About Us**


MaxVal started as an IP services company in 2004, with a keen focus on efficiency, cost\-effectiveness, and continuous improvement through metric\-based processes. Our focus on these core values led to the tech\-enablement of our offerings even before this buzzword became an industry standard. Over the years, MaxVal developed many internal applications to increase our quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. As these systems grew and became more sophisticated, we have productized them and offered them to our clients. Today, MaxVal serves over 650 clients across the full IP life cycle with the industry's leading products and services. our 730 plus employees represent the most IP and tech\-savvy individuals in the industry. At MaxVal, we do the right things and innovate ceaselessly as a winning team to achieve customer success and employee success.  

  

### **Job Description**


### **Role Overview**

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain high\-availability enterprise web applications. You will build modern frontend interfaces using Angular 17\+, implement RESTful ASP.NET Core Web APIs, manage data architectures on MS SQL Server/PostGre SQL, and deploy services across AWS cloud infrastructure.  

  



  

  

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Frontend Development:** Build high\-performance, reactive single\-page applications (SPAs) using Angular 17\+ featuring Signals, standalone components, dynamic routing, and RxJS.
* **Web API \& Backend:** Design, secure, and maintain RESTful Web APIs and microservices using C\# and .NET Core / .NET 8\+. Implement JWT authentication, CORS policies, rate limiting, and Entity Framework Core.
* **Database Engineering:** Write optimized T\-SQL queries, stored procedures, views, and index structures in MS SQL Server. Conduct query performance tuning and execution plan analysis.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** Provision, deploy, and monitor APIs and web assets on AWS. Maintain automated CI/CD pipelines.
* **Software Quality \& Security (Optional):** Write unit and integration tests (xUnit/NUnit for APIs, Jasmine/Karma for Angular). Enforce Web API security best practices (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, OWASP standards).

  

  

  

  

### **Requirements**


* **Frontend:** 2\+ years with Angular (with hands\-on experience in Angular 17 or higher, TypeScript, and modern state management).
* **Backend \& APIs:** 5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing RESTful ASP.NET Core Web APIs using C\#, .NET Core / .NET 8, and Entity Framework Core.
* **Database:** Strong proficiency in MS SQL Server, database design, T\-SQL scripting, and query optimization.
* **AWS Cloud:** Working experience with AWS core services
* **Tools \& Protocols:** Solid understanding of API documentation tools (Swagger/OpenAPI), Git, Docker, and CI/CD tools (AWS CodePipeline, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions)

title: .NET Full Stack Developer - US Client Engagement & AI Solutions
description:
We are seeking a talented **.NET Full Stack Developer** with a passion for **AI Solutions** and client\-facing engagements to join our dynamic team in Coimbatore. In this role, you will work closely with **US\-based clients**, bridging business requirements with cutting\-edge technical execution. The ideal candidate should have **6 months to 1 year of experience** in C\# and .NET development, along with a strong foundation in modern cloud architectures, REST APIs, and basic AI/ML integrations. If you thrive in agile environments and want to build the next generation of intelligent software, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

* **Client Engagement \& Collaboration:** Directly interact with US\-based stakeholders to gather requirements, provide technical updates, and deliver robust software solutions tailored to their business objectives.
* **Full Stack Development:** Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality, scalable applications using **C\#, .NET Core, and modern front\-end frameworks**.
* **AI Solutions Integration:** Integrate artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities (such as GCP Vertex AI, ADK, MCP and LLM\-based APIs) into enterprise applications.
* **Cloud \& DevOps:** Leverage **Azure Services** and utilize **Docker** for containerization, collaborating with the DevOps team to streamline continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
* **API \& Database Management:** Build, secure, and consume **REST APIs**, managing backend data efficiently using **SQL** and modern database technologies.
* **Code Quality \& Agile Delivery:** Write clean, testable, and maintainable code following **Agile Scrum methodologies**, actively participating in code reviews and architecture discussions.
* **Performance \& Security:** Implement industry best practices for application security, scalability, performance tuning, and troubleshooting complex software issues.

Requirements

* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* **Experience:** Professional experience in **C\# and .NET Core development**.
* **AI \& Cloud Acumen:** Familiarity or hands\-on experience integrating AI solutions
* **Client\-Facing Skills:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with proven experience or readiness to manage **US client communications and presentations**.
* **Core Technical Stack:** Strong working knowledge of **REST APIs, SQL, and modern front\-end technologies**.
* **DevOps \& Containerization:** Familiarity with **Docker**, containerization, and basic DevOps practices.
* **Methodology \& Soft Skills:** Strong understanding of **Agile Scrum**, exceptional problem\-solving abilities, high attention to detail, and the capability to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.

Pay: ₹144,000\.00 \- ₹240,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* What is your current CTC?
* What is your expected CTC?
* What is your notice Period? How soon you can join if you selected for this role?
* Why you want to switch the current company?
* Do you have any offers in hand? if any provide the details
* What is your experience in .Net?
* Have you worked with Onsite/ Oversea Clients and or Development Team?
* Are you good with working on Alternate Saturdays? (We will mostly use this Alternate Saturday for internal meeting, Trainings and Catchup on the sprint tasks.)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person
